title: Ship Pipeline
description: Pipeline definition — a DAG of steps executed against a job branch.

name.description: Pipeline identifier. Lowercase kebab-case; matches the filename stem.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this pipeline does.

auto_merge.description: When true, runtime runs `git merge` on the job branch after the final step.

vars.description: String variables available to step templates.

max_retries.description: Default retry count applied to each step unless overridden.

step_specs.description: Optional per-step spec bodies, aligned by index with `steps`.

agents.description: Short form — a sequential list of agent profile IDs.

steps.description: Long form — explicit DAG of steps.

id.description: Unique step ID within the pipeline.

type.description: Step kind. `gate` is a legacy alias for `review` (agent-backed reviewer).

agent.description: Agent profile ID. Required for agent/review steps.

run.description: Shell command. Presence marks the step as a run step.

human.description: Human-in-the-loop prompt. Pipeline halts until a human action.

goal.description: Brief description of what this step should accomplish.

after.description: Step IDs this step depends on. Empty or absent = root step.

parallel.description: Fan-out group — nested steps run in parallel.

gate.description: Declarative diff-rule check on the step's output (orthogonal to `type`).

match.description: Glob pattern against changed file paths (e.g. "**/*.rs").

min.description: Minimum (or for forbid, maximum) matching file count.
